blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Mark Vicelles and defending champion Thanongsak Simsri both made weight Friday, clearing the final hurdle before their International Boxing Federation (IBF) world light flyweight title showdown on Saturday, September 26, in Shizuoka, Japan. Simsri tipped the scales at 48.5 kilograms, while Vicelles came in slightly heavier at 48.6 kg during the official weigh-in at the Fujisanmesse Industrial Exchange Exhibition Hall. The two fighters are now set for their championship clash at the same venue.
